description:
Functional specifications/files: existing Connect.MutationEvents/MutationEventWorker delivery, NodeRouter, Agent receiver; acknowledged fanout to all discovered Agent nodes, aggregate all acknowledgments, retry partial/discovery/zero-target failures, duplicates safe. No parallel jobs.
Tests first: multi-node targets, partial failure, lost acknowledgment, failed discovery, zero target, duplicate/reordered replay.
Branches: all success, partial, timeout, no target, malformed payload.
Mocking: injected NodeRouter discovery/dispatch seam; real Event and local receiver.
Docs: Engine delivery pipeline and explicit eventual consistency limitations.
Action reuse: extend existing transactional mutation notification and worker plus NodeRouter; no new queue or operation.

comments.text: Extended NodeRouter with discovered-node acknowledged dispatch_all fanout and routed the existing Connect mutation worker through it. Partial, zero-target, discovery, and remote delivery failures remain retryable; no parallel notification path was added.

title: [zaq-jrg] Fan out credential notifications to all Agent nodes
